name: bioscan_qc_uksi_name_status
description: Absent: This could mean that the taxon name is not in the UK, not in the UKSI list or potentially misspelled. Further investigation is required, please check the BOLD BIN for multiple species names where one of these may be a recommended UKSI taxon. Recommended: This is the accepted or valid name for a taxon in the UKSI, typically based on the most recent and widely accepted taxonomic consensus. Synonym: Synonyms are historical or alternative names that have been used for the same taxon but are no longer the recommended names. They may include older scientific names, misapplied names, or names resulting from taxonomic revisions (e.g., species being moved to different genera). please check the BOLD BIN for multiple species names where one of these may be a recommended UKSI taxon.
